title: [3.0-beta2] Graph render glitch when changing between 6/12/18/24 hr view
symptom: When long pressing the graph area to change between views, the graph briefly displays the requested number of hours of history, then renders predictions and shortens the history part, causing glucose dots to pile up in a vertical line at the leftmost position. The glitch disappears when the next glucose value is received.
cause: The issue was not explicitly diagnosed in the thread; a maintainer suggested it might be caused by DST change, but the reporter disagreed. Another commenter noted it is similar to issue #801 and mentioned a previous attempt to fix it by preparing data for max range, but no root cause was confirmed.
fix: The issue was resolved by a commit: https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/commit/2ad7d9f4d236ca6adb76b6afa9e51ecd3a354bb4. No specific configuration change was described.
